decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit has had a dedicated page for two consecutive years, which suggests it is an established equipment line that fits the firm's dental and hearing lab supply business.
The orthopedic shoe last was launched recently with its own page, and it extends the firm's custom-fit manufacturing into orthopedics, so it deserves more time to build demand.
The post-curing unit is only mentioned on the website, which signals lower visibility, but it complements 3D-printing workflows and costs little to keep in the portfolio.
